RECORDED FOR L9, NO VERDICT. Full text: org/missions/D9/IRPT/IRPT_BCKEND/deliverables/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~V/the-two-key-packet.result.md blob 4dc9891f7d20d5908eac49b1799da11cd76a368b @141b796c48, section R66-AC2.
1. DESIGN OR ACCIDENT. The partner table is the intended identity bridge (modules/partner-firm-table/main.tf:5-7 @b95c935160; edge index.mjs:202-205 @b95c935160, 'Phase 0 identity overhaul 2026-04-15'). IRPT depends on it TRANSITIVELY: it reads X-Advisor-Id (_scope/resolve.py:92-96, 174 @b95c935160), which the edge injects from the token's advisorId, which is minted only from the partner table. The IRPT records mis-located it (RT2 cited jwt.ts:167-187 without tracing the source; the first packet put the advisor on the user row). That is a record inheriting an unexamined source, not a code accident. Named consequence, not measured: two independently written spellings of one identity (ownership-map key; hand-written partner advisorKey, main.tf:11 @b95c935160) must agree, with no validator between them found by this census.
2. THE NO-BOOK LOGIN EXPOSURE. The mechanism is re-cited (row S88): the L0 tier (tier_policy.mjs:9 @b95c935160), the authorizer's own-firm allowedFirmIds (portal-authorizer/index.mjs:125-154 @b95c935160), and opal-partners-data gating only L1/L2 (:1673-1680 @b95c935160); canAccessFirm has 0 callers. What the CTO's census takes: per firm with an opal-partner-* table, firmId-index PROFILE e-mails against partner e-mails and advisorKey by projection; count no-row logins and empty-advisorKey rows over each firm's PROFILE count; separately count firms with no partner table; print counts only. The portal smoke logins (S87) are in that population.
3. FWD-11. It needs NEITHER partner rows nor a new mint path. OPAL_GLOBAL is decided only by the SSM roster /opal/irpt/opal-principal-roster matched on X-User-Email (_scope/global.py:10, 65, 140; _scope/resolve.py:181-183 @b95c935160). An opal-capital login skips the partner lookup (auth.ts:207 @b95c935160), is tier internal (jwt.ts:168 @b95c935160) and has ALL firms at the authorizer (portal-authorizer/index.mjs:133-136 @b95c935160). A token carries ONE firmId, so partner rows in every firm would give FIRM_ADVISOR in one firm, never global. The path is an Opal login plus the roster parameter, a separate act with its own sign-off.
